text:
lina: deploy-bot flagged a promotion failure for eu-central, holding promotion to prod.
deploy-bot: PROMOTION_PAUSED: payments-chart v3.2.0 -> postupgrade hook failed on eu-central-1 (pod payments-migration-0 CrashLoopBackOff)
logs: 
```
ERROR: failed to create service account token: failed to mount secrets for default-sa
stack: k8s.io/hostpath/...
```
devops-bot: Created manual hold and rollback job (job/rollback-payments-1714690000). Notifying infra-oncall. :rotating_light:
sam: assigning to @hao for initial triage. If SA mount is broken we may be able to hotpatch the Job to use existing secret.
marta: quick look at values: `serviceAccount.create: true` and `serviceAccount.name: payments-sa` for 3.2.0. On 3.1.7 it uses `serviceAccount.annotations: {}` only.
hao: will investigate node+pod events now — ETA ~20m. can someone paste the helm diff from the promotion run?
lina: here is the diff we captured: 
```
+ serviceAccount:
+   create: true
+   name: payments-sa
- # removed bootstrap secret mount from chart templates
```
pat: is rollback to 3.1.7 acceptable? change window open until 03:00 UTC.
sam: preference: avoid full rollback if possible. Option 1: patch the failing postupgrade Job to point to `existing-payments-secret` and resume promotion. Option 2: pin eu-central to 3.1.7 and continue global promotion for other regions.
hao: quick test: I patched the postupgrade Job with secretOverride: existing-payments-secret and restarted. Pod came up but the migration job failed due to permission denied when accessing configmap.
marta: that suggests the SA doesn't have the right RBAC bindings in 3.2.0 templates. 3.2.0 added a new role with `verbs: [get, list, patch]` but the RoleBinding creation is conditional on `rbac.create` which defaults to false in our values.
pat: so two-way: either set `rbac.create: true` and re-run, or revert to 3.1.7 for eu-central only.
release-bot: Drafting release note update: "eu-central promotion of payments-chart v3.2.0 held due to postupgrade RBAC/serviceAccount mismatch; patch rolling plan in progress." Link: https://go/rel/1714690000-draft
devops-bot: Action taken: pinned eu-central release to payments-chart:3.1.7 (region override) and queued a follow-up hotfix branch `hotfix/payments/rbac-3.2.1` for the chart repo. Promotion resumed for other regions. :white_check_mark:
lina: thanks. @release-bot please include rollback and FAQ on platform incident page.
release-bot: included. Also added CC to legal/compliance per data-plane migration note.
infra-oncall: monitoring eu-central for any remaining rollout artifacts. If we need to fully rollback cluster-wide, call me immediately.
sam: follow-up owners: @hao to validate RBAC patch, @marta to prepare values override guidance, @pat to sign off on regional pin, @lina to update release notes and customer comms. Closing hold once hotfix is cut.
hao: starting RBAC patch PR now. will post PR link when ready.
lina: OK closing thread for now. will update when hotfix merged or if rollback escalates. :eyes:
